Nearest City: Connellsville, PA
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: UNKNOWN MATERIAL
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: NATURAL GAS INDUSTRY
Skytruth Analysis
MARCH 31, 2011 AT APPROX 12:00 A LIGHT MALODOROUS SMELL WAS NOTICED IN THE AIR. WHEN GETTING OUT OF A VEHICLE THAT SAME REPUGNANT SMELL WAS IN THE AIR ONLY IN A HIGHER CONCENTRATION AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE REPORTING PARTY'S CHEST BEGAN TO BURN INTERNALLY AS IF THEY HAD HEARTBURN, THEY GOT AN INSTANT HEADACHE AND THEIR STOMACH BECAME UPSET. THEIR LIPS BECAME BITTER AND THE SMELL WAS ON THEIR CLOTHING. THEY CONTACTED NEIGHBORS WHO LIVE APPROX 1.5 MILE SOUTH OF INCIDENT LOCATION. THEY COULD SMELL THE HORRIBLE ODOR TOO AND WERE HAVING SYMPTOMS SIMILAR TO THE REPORTING PARTY. COLUMBIA GAS OF PA WAS CONTACTED TO REPORT THE SMELL BY THE REPORTING PARTY AND THEIR NEIGHBORS. A FIELD TECH ARRIVED AT THE NEIGHBORS HOME SHORTLY AFTER THE PHONE CALL. THE TECH INFORMED THE REPORTING PARTY THAT IT WAS NOT FROM COLUMBIA GAS BUT COULD BE COMING FROM A WELL SITE NEARBY. A FOLLOW UP CALL FROM THE REPORTING PARTY'S OFFICE AND THEY SPOKE WITH A CUSTOMER SERVICE REP. THEY DID NOT HAVE ANY DOCUMENTATION OF THE CALL PLACED TO THEIR EMERGENCY LINE. THEY WERE ASKED TO PLEASE RESEARCH AND GET BACK WITH THE REPORTING PARTY. CUSTOMER SERVICE REP TOLD THEM THAT THE HORRIBLE SMELLS ARE NOT FROM COLUMBIA GAS LINES BUT ARE FROM THE DEEP MARCELLUS WELLS THEMSELVES AND THAT THESE WELLS ARE RELEASING GASES IN THE NIGHT. THEY ARE RECEIVING SEVERAL PHONE CALLS CONCERNING THE ODORS. PLEASE INVESTIGATE THIS SITUATION AS THIS ODOR HAS BEEN PRESENT BEFORE ON DECEMBER 10, 2010 AND DECEMBER 11, 2010. BOTH DAYS 911 WAS CONTACTED AND ON BOTH DAYS THE REPORTING PARTY WAS ILL FROM SMELLING THIS ODOR.
